Flow.description:
Created by: Elevation Solutions
User-launched (or launched from an Individual Application record page) master screen flow that orchestrates Zeta sub screen-flows for Individual Application review. This master flow’s job is primarily navigation + sequencing.

formulas.description: Confirm overall eligibility specific Resolves the selected eligibility action based on which action button was used. Passed into subflows to control downstream behavior without exposing UI-specific variables.
formulas.name: fxSelectedEligibilityAction
formulas.expression: IF( {!confirmbutton.value} = "Mark Eligible", "Mark Eligible", IF( {!buttonsReviewNameandMarkWithdrawn.value} = "Mark Withdrawn/Declined", "Mark Withdrawn/Declined", "" ) )

Flow.label: Individual Application (Screenflow) Priorities and Eligibility

textTemplates.description: Displayed when Age Review picklist = “Denied”. Clearly communicates that the application failed age eligibility.
textTemplates.name: TT_Age_Validation_Denied
textTemplates.text: Birthdate / Age Validation Denied. The age inconsistency has been reviewed and the request for an exception was denied.

textTemplates.description: Displayed when Age Review picklist = “Exception made”. Confirms the application has been reviewed and approved by exception.
textTemplates.name: TT_Age_Validation_Exception_Made
textTemplates.text:
Age Validated. An exception has been approved for this application.
Reason: {!Get_Records_Individual_Application.Grade_Inconsistency_Approved_Reason__c}

textTemplates.description: Displayed in the master flow when Age Inconsistency Flag = TRUE AND Age Review picklist is blank. Indicates staff action is required.
textTemplates.name: TT_Age_Validation_Needs_Review
textTemplates.text: Birthdate / Age Validation Required. This application has an age inconsistency and must be reviewed.

textTemplates.description: Single-line red alert message indicating the application fails residency requirements and cannot be marked Eligible.
textTemplates.name: TT_ResidencyRestriction_RedAlert
textTemplates.text:
Residency Restriction: This application cannot be marked Eligible.
• Pre-K: Mailing City must be New York
• K–12: Mailing State must be NY

textTemplates.description: Shown when a user attempts to proceed without selecting any Priority Items for validation. Uses standard Yellow = Needs Review styling and clear, corrective guidance.
textTemplates.name: TT_Warning_No_Priorities_Selected
textTemplates.text: No priorities were selected for review. Please select at least one priority item to validate, then try again.

textTemplates.name: txt_AppSummary
textTemplates.text:
Applicant: {!Get_Records_Individual_Application.Account.FirstName} {!Get_Records_Individual_Application.Account.MiddleName} {!Get_Records_Individual_Application.Account.LastName}
Grade Applying To: {!Get_Records_Individual_Application.Grade_Applying_To__c}
Birthdate: {!Get_Records_Individual_Application.Account.PersonBirthdate}
School Start Age: {!Get_Records_Individual_Application.School_Start_Age__c}
Address: {!Get_Records_Individual_Application.Account.PersonMailingStreet}, {!Get_Records_Individual_Application.Account.PersonMailingCity}, {!Get_Records_Individual_Application.Account.PersonMailingState} {!Get_Records_Individual_Application.Account.PersonMailingPostalCode}

textTemplates.description: Red callout indicating District Priority still needs validation.
textTemplates.name: txt_DistrictPriority_NeedsValidation
textTemplates.text: District Priority: Still needs to be validated.

textTemplates.name: txt_DistrictPriority_Red
textTemplates.text: Student District ID: Not set.

textTemplates.description: Shown when the Individual Application is in an applied / in-progress state.

textTemplates.name: txt_Status_Eligible

textTemplates.description: Shown when Zeta Staff Priority has not been validated.
textTemplates.name: txt_ZetaPriority_Red
textTemplates.text: Priorities still need to be verified. Select a priority from the table and then select the Validate Priority button below to review for approval.
